ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the opponent in match play
title: Ball accidentally hits opponent in match play
question: During match play, if your ball accidentally hits your opponent, what should you do according to the Rules?

choices.text: Replay the stroke only if both balls were on the putting green.
Always replay the shot, wherever you are on the course.
Play the ball as it lies unless both balls were on the green.
Add a penalty stroke and replay the shot.

explanation: In match play, if your ball accidentally hits your opponent, play your ball as it lies except when both balls were on the green before the stroke. Then, you must replay the shot.
